items.q: How costly is poorly controlled type 2 diabetes?
items.a: Every year of poorly controlled T2D costs about **100 days of life**. Unwin has helped **157 patients** into **drug-free** T2D remission via diet.

items.q: What is the "long silent scream" of fatty liver?
items.a: Excess carbs → insulin stores belly fat + **hepatic fat for ~10 silent years** (Roy Taylor) → insulin resistance → more insulin → pancreatic fat → T2D. High glucose damages arterial **glycocalyx within 6 hours**.

items.q: How do remission odds change by stage on low carb?
items.a: Prediabetes → **93%** normal blood sugar; early T2D → **73%**; after **5 years** → **50%**. Stitch in time — wait and the odds fall.

items.q: How does Unwin make glycemic load intuitive?
items.a: **Teaspoons of sugar equivalent** (4g cubes): cornflakes **8**, potato **9**, banana **6**, chocolate **7.5**, 150g boiled rice **10**. Only **one sugar cube** sits in entire **5L** of blood at normal levels — a banana doubles his CGM.
**Starch is glucose molecules holding hands** — digestion frees them as sugar again. Cereal + OJ + snacks + sandwich + cake + pizza is sugar on sugar all day.

items.q: What label traps should people watch?
items.a: UK labels exclude fiber from carbs (US includes); **4g carbs ≈ 1 tsp sugar**; dried fruit can be **60–70%** sugar with a health halo; white chocolate ~**80%** sugar; barbecue sauce ~**30 cubes**/bottle.

items.q: What is Jen Unwin's GRIN model?
items.a: **Goals, Resources, Increments, Notice** — hope-based coaching that replaces doctor-as-leaflet moaning. Consistency beats a six-pack deadline.

items.q: Why does moderation fail food addicts?
items.a: ~**14%** show ultra-processed food addiction. Protocol: honesty → identify **trigger foods** → **abstinence** plan. Policing loved ones produces **deceit**, not recovery.
As a **partial** answer that quiets cravings, not the root cause. For severe cases: **low carb + CGM + GLP-1** "triple therapy" when someone can abstain but cannot moderate.

items.q: What simple metabolic screen does he recommend?
items.a: **Waist < half height** — the string test. The average person may spend ~**23 sick years** at end of life; UK taxpayer cost of UPF consequences cited around **£7,000/yr**.

items.q: How strongly does Unwin link diet to cancer?
items.a: After smoking, **diet is the next commonest cause of cancer** — eight cancers linked to diabetes; hyperinsulinemia inhibits apoptosis; prevention is underweighted vs treatment.

items.q: What did Unwin learn after 25 years of "eat less, move more"?
items.a: He spent **25 years blaming patients**; the failure was his advice (All-Bran + skim milk). Low carb made hunger vanish and liver function improve **33–50%** in weeks in the 2013 Monday-night cohort.
